svg.desc: Wadi Dayqah Dam LOCATION Oman CLIENT Sultanate of Oman Ministry of Irrigation / VINCI COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2011 N/A DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2011, the Wadi Dayqah Dam in Oman was constructed to collect periodic rainfall and stands as the highest dam in the country. Services provided included architecture, structural and civil engineering, and MEP, for the Sultanate of Oman Ministry of Irrigation in collaboration with VINCI. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
